/* LocationPurgeMapper.selectPurgeScope */ SELECT IFNULL(SUM(S.SRC = 'ATTD'), 0) AS attdGpsRows , IFNULL(SUM(S.SRC = 'TBM_ATT'), 0) AS tbmAttendanceRows , IFNULL(SUM(S.SRC = 'TBM_SES'), 0) AS tbmSessionRows , MIN(S.COLLECTED_YMD) AS oldestCollected , MAX(S.COLLECTED_YMD) AS latestCollected FROM ( SELECT 'ATTD' AS SRC , G.API_CALL_DATE AS COLLECTED_YMD FROM TB_USER_ATTD_GPS G WHERE G.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND G.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND (G.LAT IS NOT NULL OR G.LON IS NOT NULL OR G.LAT_ENC IS NOT NULL OR G.LON_ENC IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TBM_ATT' , DATE_FORMAT(A.INSERT_DATE, '%Y%m%d') FROM TB_TBM_ATTENDANCE A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.USER_TYPE_CD = #{userTypeCd} AND (A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT IS NOT NULL OR A.ENTRY_GPS_LON IS NOT NULL OR A.ENTRY_GPS_LAT_ENC IS NOT NULL OR A.ENTRY_GPS_LON_ENC IS NOT NULL)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'TBM_SES' , DATE_FORMAT(T.INSERT_DATE, '%Y%m%d') FROM TB_TBM_SESSION T WHERE T.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND T.MANAGER_USER_CD = #{userCd} AND (T.MANAGER_GPS_LAT IS NOT NULL OR T.MANAGER_GPS_LON IS NOT NULL OR T.MANAGER_GPS_LAT_ENC IS NOT NULL OR T.MANAGER_GPS_LON_ENC IS NOT NULL) ) S
